title: Run Autonomous Repair through trusted-main coding runtime
goal: Make Autonomous Repair execute the current trusted-main run-coder runtime instead of a potentially stale candidate-branch copy, so infrastructure fixes on main apply to old candidate branches without changing candidate contents or review authority.
scope: Primary-maintainer scope: modify only .github/workflows/agent-repair.yml and a narrowly-scoped deterministic test under tests/ExternalReviewProtocol.Tests/**.

Materialize agents/runtime/run-coder.sh from origin/main after the existing trusted-main fetch and execute that trusted copy from RUNNER_TEMP while the working directory remains the candidate checkout.

Do not alter repair prompt contents, provider/model ordering, timeouts, workspace reset/fallback semantics, candidate author identity, reviewer policy, repair budgets, task authority, runner configuration, secrets, vendor payload handling, TIA worker/generator/domain/compiler semantics or IndustrialMDE.
This protected workflow repair is materially authored by primary ChatGPT and requires fresh isolated chatgpt-secondary review for the exact candidate SHA.

requirements: Autonomous Repair no longer executes agents/runtime/run-coder.sh from the candidate branch.
The workflow obtains the executable run-coder.sh bytes from origin/main after trusted-main fetch and invokes that trusted copy from RUNNER_TEMP.
Candidate working tree remains the agent branch so coding edits still target the candidate branch and protected-path diff validation remains unchanged.
Repair prompt construction, OpenRouter-first/DeepSeek-fallback policy, timeouts, stdout/stderr capture, audit, workspace reset semantics, author identity and review provenance are unchanged.
A deterministic test asserts the trusted-main materialization and invocation and rejects direct candidate-branch run-coder execution.
Fresh isolated chatgpt-secondary CODE_REVIEW APPROVE is bound to the exact candidate SHA before merge.
tia: No Windows/TIA execution is required for this infrastructure-only workflow repair.
After merge, repeat the OLQ-DIAG-001 CHANGES_REQUIRED repair flow for PR #41 and verify Autonomous Repair proceeds beyond prompt transport.
